theorems.name: Submission.simon_lift_velocity_mem_range_fderiv
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (x₀ : Rn n) (c : ℝ → Rn n) (γ : ℝ → Rn N) (v : Rn N), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x₀ → Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ x₀) → Tendsto c (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 x₀) → (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), γ t = ψ (c t)) → HasDerivAt γ v 0 → v ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x₀).toLinearMap
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
